lines.zh: 我飞得很低，脚尖擦着草尖
lines.en: I fly low, toes brushing the grass tips

lines.zh: 矮矮的一团影子跟着我移动
lines.en: A short round shadow moves with me
I advance in little hops

lines.zh: 手臂拖在身后，晃来晃去
lines.en: My arms trail behind me, swinging
I slip between the treetops
My ki holds me off the ground

lines.zh: 我撞开一片叶子，继续飘
lines.en: I push through leaves and drift on
I take the long way on purpose
My boots step on nothing
I drift along, cracking my knuckles
I skim along the ground a while

lines.zh: 我的影子在你脚边停了一下
lines.en: My shadow pauses by your feet
I squat on a rock and kick my legs
I shove my face into my hands

lines.zh: 我盯着一个蚂蚁看很久
lines.en: I watch one ant for a long time

lines.zh: 我嘴里含着什么，慢慢嚼
lines.en: I chew slowly on something
My feeler twitches now and then
I hum a tune with no shape

lines.zh: 风把我的衣服吹得鼓起来
lines.en: Wind puffs my clothes out
I count my own fingers
I kick a pebble back and forth
I sit up suddenly, then flop back
I sniff my own hand
I yawn and it gets wider

lines.zh: 有个东西飞过去，我没追
lines.en: Something flies by; I let it go
I'm getting a little bored of waiting
You're taller; I look up at you
I tilt my head, eyes narrowing

lines.zh: 你的气不弱，我闻得出来
lines.en: Your ki isn't weak; I can tell

lines.zh: 我伸手，比了比你的高度
lines.en: I reach out and measure your height
Are you going to fight me
I grin and my teeth are very white
You step back; I step in
I float up to your eye level
I stare at your weapon
You talk; I'm listening

lines.zh: 我的手指在空气里戳了戳
lines.en: My fingers poke at the air
You have a nice smell
I look you over like I'm pricing you

lines.zh: 你别站那么直，我不喜欢
lines.en: Don't stand so straight; I don't like it
I want to see how fast you are first
What are you smiling at? I don't get it
I look up and my neck clicks
I yelp and clutch my head
The hit sends me drifting crooked
I stagger back two steps
I bare my teeth, and it isn't a smile
Half my ki scatters
I shake the arm that got hit
That one stung my pride

lines.zh: 我低头瞅了瞅那道口子
lines.en: I glance down at the gash
I've stopped grinning; my face feels stiff
I grit my teeth with a thin sound
Is that food? Give it
It smells sweet, so I want it
I grab for it and miss
You hold it high, so I fly up
I bite down right beside your hand
That's not enough; far from it
I hold it in my mouth, savoring
Is there more? I can smell it
Hiding it won't help
I'll want more when this is gone

lines.zh: 你撞上我，我们两个都晃
lines.en: You hit me and we both wobble
My head knocks your knee

lines.zh: 我被撞得翻了个身，又转回来
lines.en: The bump flips me; I tumble back
You step right over my head
We meet with a dull thump
I push and you take two steps back
I'm too short; you didn't see me
We squeeze into the same gap between trees
You've stepped on the back of my foot
I brace against you to stand

lines.zh: 另一个矮矮的影子过来了
lines.en: Another short shadow comes over
We knock heads and laugh loudly
I split my food with her
We fly fast circles around each other
She's a bit taller; I don't accept that
We squat on the rock together
Her feeler touches mine
I pull her into a spin
Neither of us says anything

lines.zh: 以后打架我们两个一起上
lines.en: Next fight, we both go in
I snatch it up and stuff it in a pocket
Can I hit someone with this
I bite it and my tooth aches
I hold it up to the light
It feels cool in my hand
I toss it up and catch it
I throw it away; it's no fun
I'll keep this to throw at trees
I hide it behind my back; you can't see

lines.zh: 你一动，我的头就转过去
lines.en: You move and my head snaps around
I float up a little above you
My ki flares out
If you run, I won't allow it
I smile, just once
I clench my fist and the knuckles crack
I've memorized your ki
Do I move first, or you
I point at you
I land and the dust jumps
You look sturdy enough
Now I feel like fighting
Don't go; I've only started
Short I may be, but not weak
I push my sleeves up
I fly low circles around you

lines.zh: 手指一弹，小气弹过去了
lines.en: A flick and a small ki blast flies

lines.zh: 你跳到一边，我又发一颗
lines.en: You leap aside; I fire another
My ki blasts string together
I chase you along the ground
Wherever you dodge, I turn
I laugh, happier with each shot
A ki wave swells in my hands
You back against a wall; perfect
I don't pause; three blasts at once
My arm stretches a little longer
You raise a guard and the blast bursts

lines.zh: 我在数你还剩多少力气
lines.en: I'm counting what strength you have left

lines.zh: 地面被炸出一小片焦黑
lines.en: The blasts scorch a small patch of ground
I miss on purpose once
Your footwork has come apart
I wait for you to tire
I've closed this circle
I punch you right on the knee

lines.zh: 我跳起来，头撞你的下巴
lines.en: I leap and headbutt your jaw

lines.zh: 我的手臂拉长，抽你侧脸
lines.en: My arm stretches and cracks your cheek
I kick twice in the air
You're knocked back a step

lines.zh: 我抓住你的裤腿往后拽
lines.en: I grab your trouser leg and yank

lines.zh: 这一下打在你护甲上，很响
lines.en: That one rings loud on your armor

lines.zh: 我贴地滑过去，撞你脚踝
lines.en: I slide low and clip your ankle
I twist and come back with a backhand
Good block; is your hand numb
I land and leave two small craters
A ki blast arrives with the punch
You're shoved back into a tree
I laugh once and charge again

lines.zh: 这次我打空了，差点摔倒
lines.en: I miss this time and nearly fall
I get up and wipe the grit from my mouth
A small shadow drops in

lines.zh: 我从半空翻了个身，落地
lines.en: I flip in midair and land
My ki blows the dust away first
I tilt my head at you, curious
I straighten up; I'm shorter than you thought
The air still holds some heat

lines.zh: 我从上面下来，脚先着地
lines.en: I come down feet first

lines.zh: 我嗅了嗅，找到你的位置
lines.en: I sniff and locate you
The grass is pressed into a ring
I raise a fist as if to show off
My shadow is much too small
I'm here; deal with it
My knuckles are still cracking

lines.zh: 我落地的地方陷了一点
lines.en: The ground dips where I land
I sweep the area first
Plenty of room to fight here
My ki is still up

lines.zh: 我一步一步往你那边走
lines.en: I walk toward you step by step
Fire burns me and I swat at it
I hit the ground and bounce twice

lines.zh: 水灌进我的鼻子，我咳不出来
lines.en: Water fills my nose and I can't cough it out
The blast throws me into the air
An arrow sticks in my shoulder

lines.zh: 那股力量掐住了我的气
lines.en: That force pinches my ki shut

lines.zh: 雷劈在我头上，我眼前发黑
lines.en: Lightning hits my head and my sight goes dark

lines.zh: 什么都没有了，我抓不到东西
lines.en: Nothing left; I can't grab hold
